title: In This Town, It Snows When You Lie

publish.title: It SNOWS Every Time You Lie In This Town #shorts
publish.description: In this town, every lie makes it snow, and one kid's tiny fib about his homework buries the whole city. What is the smallest lie you ever told?
publish.caption: In this town, it snows every time you lie ❄️🤥

scenes.line: In this town, it *snows* every time somebody lies.
scenes.title: IN THIS TOWN...

scenes.line: Small lie, a few flakes. Big lie, a *blizzard*.
Jay said he *loved* broccoli. Three flakes fell.
Everybody looked up. Everybody *knew*.
So we never lie. Our summers last *forever*.
Then one Monday, I forgot my *homework*.
The teacher asked where it was. My brain *froze*.
I said my dog *ate* it.
I do not have a *dog*.
Outside, the first snowflake *landed*.
The teacher looked at the sky. Then at *me*.
So I added: he is a very *hungry* dog.
The snow got *heavier*. I kept talking.
His name is Sir Barks. He has a *passport*.
By lunch, the whole town was *buried*.
Cars stopped. Trains stopped. Jay's nose *stopped*.
Everyone knew it was a lie. Nobody knew *whose*.
I could have told the truth right *then*.
Instead, I drew a *poster* of Sir Barks. Missing.
The snow reached the *rooftops*.
Then my little brother started looking for my *dog*.
In a blizzard. With a tiny bowl of *food*.
He believed me. That was the *worst* part.
So I stood in the snow and *shouted* it.
There is no dog! I just forgot my *homework*!
The wind stopped. The snow *stopped*.
And the sun came back like nothing *happened*.
Max was not mad. He was just sad about the *dog*.
The teacher gave me extra homework. *Fair*.
And the town made me shovel every single *street*.
But that weekend, Mom brought home a real *puppy*.
We named him Sir Barks. Now my lie is finally *true*.
